capabilities: Play audio from a sidebar player that keeps playing across note scrolls and panel closes
Set a per-track work marker on the waveform and play from it
Build, sort, filter and search playlists from a note or folder
Track play counts, listened time, tempo and key per audio file
Drag tracks out to apps like REAPER or copy them into notes as embedded waveforms
extras: Mobile support is limited: the drag-out and open-externally features are desktop-only; interface also ships in Russian; data is stored in data.json keyed by file path and follows renames.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's embedded audio unloads as the note scrolls, and playback cuts off.
problem: Obsidian's embedded audio player unloads when the note scrolls or the view closes, interrupting playback while writing.

relations.evidence: Open externally (ported from the Open Audio Externally plugin)

summary: Sidebar audio player for songwriting with waveform, per-track marker, playlists, play counters, tempo/key measurement and hotkeys that survives scrolling.
